parameters.query:
INSERT INTO automation_errors
  (workflow_name, workflow_id, execution_id, execution_url, failed_node, error_message, error_stack, occurred_at)
VALUES
  (
    {{ "'" + String($json.workflow?.name || "unknown").replace(/\u0000/g, "").replace(/'/g, "''").slice(0, 255) + "'" }},
    {{ "'" + String($json.workflow?.id || "").replace(/\u0000/g, "").replace(/'/g, "''").slice(0, 255) + "'" }},
    {{ "'" + String($json.execution?.id || "").replace(/\u0000/g, "").replace(/'/g, "''").slice(0, 255) + "'" }},
    {{ "'" + String($json.execution?.url || "").replace(/\u0000/g, "").replace(/'/g, "''").slice(0, 2000) + "'" }},
    {{ "'" + String($json.execution?.lastNodeExecuted || $json.trigger?.error?.node?.name || "").replace(/\u0000/g, "").replace(/'/g, "''").slice(0, 255) + "'" }},
    {{ "'" + String($json.execution?.error?.message || $json.trigger?.error?.message || "Unspecified workflow error").replace(/\u0000/g, "").replace(/'/g, "''").slice(0, 8000) + "'" }},
    {{ "'" + String($json.execution?.error?.stack || $json.trigger?.error?.stack || "").replace(/\u0000/g, "").replace(/'/g, "''").slice(0, 16000) + "'" }},
    NOW()
  );
